| [EA-6.8](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-68-state-is-rebuilt-from-the-record) State is rebuilt from the record | MUST | Default | `engine.py` `TrustEngine.rebuild_state`, `TrustEngine.live_state` | `test_c4_replay_reproduces_state_exactly`<br>`test_c4_replay_sqlite_reopen`<br>`test_tool_floor_decisions_replay_and_keep_args_out_of_the_record` |
| [EA-6.9](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-69-sequence-not-time-orders-the-record) Sequence, not time, orders the record | MUST | Default | `record.py` (scans ordered by `sequence`) | `test_replay_follows_sequence_not_timestamps_under_clock_skew` |
| [EA-6.10](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-610-one-exact-timestamp-format) One exact timestamp format | MUST | Default | `models.py` `format_timestamp`, `parse_timestamp`, `normalise_timestamp` | `test_record_entries_validate_against_the_schema`<br>`test_every_record_timestamp_uses_the_canonical_format`<br>`test_external_rehash_of_the_stored_record_matches_the_chain`<br>`test_format_is_exact_even_at_zero_milliseconds`<br>`test_naive_datetimes_and_strings_are_rejected`<br>`test_old_forms_normalise_to_the_canonical_string`<br>`test_round_trip` |
| [EA-6.11](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-611-epoch-time-stays-at-the-edges) Epoch time stays at the edges | MUST | Default | none needed | **⚠ none** |
| [EA-6.12](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-612-the-record-is-kept-permanently) The record is kept permanently | MUST | Default | none needed (no deletion path) | `test_c5_record_has_no_edit_api` |
| [EA-6.13](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-613-references-and-labels-not-customer-content) References and labels, not customer content | MUST | Default | `models.py` `payload_hash`; `record.py` | `test_record_holds_no_customer_content`<br>`test_tool_floor_decisions_replay_and_keep_args_out_of_the_record` |
| [EA-6.14](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-614-records-follow-the-schema) Records follow the schema | MUST | Default | `models.py` (`to_dict` on each model) | `test_engine_objects_validate_against_the_schemas`<br>`test_record_entries_validate_against_the_schema` |
| [EA-6.15](../spec/requirements/06-governance-and-record.md#ea-615-approval-for-senior) Approval for Senior | MAY | Default | `governance.py` (`promote` operation, policy owner) | none |
